text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer has always felt inferior to Mejiro McQueen and the other Mejiros because they've always managed to work hard without running away. She feels unable to face them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there is one thing the runaway Mejiro Palmer has that the others don't. She's found a strong friendship she wouldn't have had otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios decides to run in the Takarazuka Kinen in order to cheer for Mejiro Palmer directly beside her.
